package shapes;

import java.util.List;

interface Shape {
    int area();
}

class Rectangle implements Shape {
    private int width;
    private int height;

    public Rectangle(int width, int height) {
        if (width > 0 && height > 0) {
            this.width = width;
            this.height = height;
        } else {
            this.width = 0;
            this.height = 0;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int area() {
        return width * height;
    }

    public int classify(int score) {
        if (score > 90) {
            return 3;
        } else if (score > 50) {
            return 2;
        }
        return 1;
    }

    public int pick(int a, int b, int c) {
        switch (a) {
            case 1:
                return b;
            case 2:
                return c;
            default:
                return a;
        }
    }

    public int loop(int n) {
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (i % 2 == 0 || i % 3 == 0) {
                total += i;
            }
        }
        while (total > 100 && n > 0) {
            total -= n;
            n--;
        }
        return total;
    }

    public <T> T identity(T x) {
        if (x == null) {
            return null;
        }
        return x;
    }

    public void risky() throws Exception {
        if (width < 0) {
            throw new Exception("bad width");
        }
    }

    public Runnable makeRunner() {
        if (width > 0) {
            return new Runnable() {
                @Override
                public void run() {
                    if (height > 0) {
                        System.out.println("ok");
                    }
                }
            };
        }
        return null;
    }
}
